paper_metadata.title: Design of refractory complex concentrated alloys combining good tensile strength and ductility at 22 – 1000 °C
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: This study investigates the refractory Nb-Mo-Ta-V alloy system, focusing on compositions that achieve a balance between tensile strength and ductility across a wide temperature range while maintaining decent formability.

This study investigated the refractory Nb-Mo-Ta-V alloy system, focusing on RCCAs with high formability and balanced tensile strength-ductility synergy across a wide temperature range.
The results obtained allowed us to determine the Nb85Mo5Ta5V5 alloy as the base composition for further modifications aiming at creating new bcc + B2 RCCAs
